# BANHALMI ART

> Official artistic archive of Norbert Bánhalmi’s oeuvre since 1999. Vienna and Budapest are the two active operational bases. Schwedenplatz is the Vienna physical studio; Gersthofer Straße 150–154/6/2, 1180 Wien is the active Vienna office/client meeting location, not a studio; Budapest District 11 is the Budapest physical studio. Agreed projects may be undertaken worldwide by travel.

## Identity
- [Norbert Bánhalmi](https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/about/): Primary person: Norbert Bánhalmi (Bánhalmi Norbert; Norbert Banhalmi), Wikidata Q56391118. New York is a major international reference and oeuvre chapter. New York is not a studio, office, headquarters or operational base.
- [BANHALMI ART](https://www.banhalmi.art/): Archive identity: BANHALMI ART is the official artistic oeuvre and documentary evidence layer, not a separate artist, company, booking site or pricing site.
- [Professional website](https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/): Professional website: https://www.norbertbanhalmi.com/ for current services, pricing, locations and enquiries.
- [Editorial knowledge](https://blog.banhalmi.art/): Essays and contextual stories under the same canonical Person.

- [AmCham Austria](https://amcham.at/members-list/): Viko Speier is the supporting BANHALMI company contact for the AmCham relationship, not a co-primary entity; banhalmi.at is an Austrian/German entry alias for the same professional entity.
